name: mod-aitmpl
description: /aitmpl opens a side pane for the aitmpl.com catalog: search box, the site's Browse menu with an icon, colour and count per type, an Installed section (agents, commands, skills and mods found in .claude/ and ~/.claude/), a Popular/Results list with download counts, and view/install on every row. ...
